function.name: create_task
function.description: Save a delegated cloud task: now, after this call ends, or once at an explicit date/time. Services are connected in Alo. Writes need exact-action approval. Results are in History; request email/callback/SMS only if the caller asks.

intent.description: research: web/general questions. summarize_emails: read the caller's own Gmail. calendar: questions about their schedule. reply_email: AI drafts a reply to one of their emails (sent only after approval). send_email: an email the caller dictates. create_calendar_event: a new event. Gmail/Calendar must be connected in the Alo app.

instruction.description: The caller's request in one or two sentences (for reply_email: what the reply should say).

email_query.description: summarize_emails / reply_email: Gmail search for the emails the caller means, e.g. 'from:ivan newer_than:7d' or 'subject:invoice'.

days_ahead.description: calendar: rolling days from now (default 7), only when the caller asks for a rolling period. For next week or specific dates use from/to.

to.description: send_email: one recipient email address (have the caller spell it).

start.description: create_calendar_event: ISO start time with timezone offset, e.g. 2026-10-12T17:00:00+03:00.

end.description: create_calendar_event: ISO end time with timezone offset.

start_mode.description: now by default; after_call only when caller wants execution after hang-up; scheduled is one-off.

run_at.description: Required for scheduled. ISO timestamp with explicit UTC offset; ask to clarify ambiguous dates and DST times.

delivery_channels.description: Only channels explicitly requested. Email means the connected Gmail account itself. History is always included.

from.description: calendar: first local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Next week means next Monday through Sunday in Europe/Sofia.

to_date.description: calendar: last local date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Use to_date, not the email-recipient to field.

messages.content: One moment while I hand that over to the agent.
